svg.title: The Compute Community Centre: a public library for compute, costed and in design, site to be chosen
svg.desc: A building in section. Ground floor: the compute room, glazed to the street, with four racks whose lights blink, and an open door people walk through. Above it the commons and cafeteria, then rest and exercise, then twelve homes, and a planted roof.
svg.text: Commons and cafeteria · 48 public AI terminals
Compute room · 19 eight-GPU nodes in four racks
A modern commons based on the public library model,
open to anyone who walks in.
COSTED · IN DESIGN · SITE TO BE CHOSEN
The door is the whole admissions policy.
